items.description: Pneumatic launch tube for C-130/KC135 and S0

notes: Early-stage engineering collaboration with USAF/Ultra PCS on pneumatic launcher system. Active technical discussion through Jan 2026 regarding UAV dimensions, tube interface details (Sonobuoy A vs CLT), and ejection velocity/acceleration specs. Tracy Harris attempted in-person meeting Feb 24-25, 2026 but timing conflict. No parts ordered, no estimate issued, no QBO invoice found. Last substantive contact Jan 15, 2026.
